notes.title: Halloween!
notes.content:
During the Halloween celebration, the experience gained per game has been increased by 50%.
Enjoy :)

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Friends, the official release of the game is scheduled for March 4th at 10:00 am PST.
Be sure to add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss out on the release date.

We are offering 15% discount to all new Peekaboo Lite players.
[b]And the current owners of the first version of the game [/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048100/Peekaboo_Hide_and_Seek/]Peekaboo[/url] [b]will have the opportunity to purchase the new version with a 30% discount as a token of gratitude![/b]

Now you can try the full free version of the game by downloading it from Google Play:
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Redaster.Peekaboo]https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Redaster.Peekaboo[/url]

And that's not all...
Follow the news.
